text:
dana: Heads up — we're seeing a sharp 5xx spike right after the canary flip for tenant_shadow_routing. /v1/generate returning 502/504 + timeouts. Multiple customer tickets (AcmeCorp) arriving. @sre-oncall can you triage?
ryan: On it. Any quick repros or logs? Which region?
dana: eu-west-1 primarily, but small trickle in us-west too. Quick curl reproducer from a failing request: 
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \"https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate\" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'
```
logs show gateway returning 502 with upstream error "missing-tenant-header" in a few traces.
support-bot: Ticket #AC-1420 from AcmeCorp: "500s and timeouts for inference calls since 12:03 UTC". Severity: P1. Contact: sara@acme.com.
christine: If it's missing tenant header we might be routing to the wrong backend variant — that flag was supposed to be dry-run (shadow) but could be wired incorrectly. Can we toggle to 0% immediately?
ryan: Checking config-store: feature tenant_shadow_routing was set to rollout: 20% for canary but the selector key was wrong (selector: tenant_id instead of header:x-tenant-id). Looks like the runtime matched empty values -> routed a chunk without tenant -> upstream auth failed -> 502.
sre-oncall: I'm pausing canary routing in the control plane (config-service) now. Switching to rollout 0%...
sre-oncall: Done. Pushed config at 12:13:42 UTC, propagated to edge in ~8s. Rolling restart not required.
mike: I'm watching metrics — 5xx rate dropped ~80% within 30s. Latency also normalizing.
dana: AcmeCorp confirms resumed success on their calls (sara@acme). Sending them a brief note. :thumbsup:
billing: FYI we saw a small spike in failed usage records during the window (~3k failures). Need to reconcile with Acme billing team later.
ryan: Reproducer that failed earlier now returns 200. Sample headers we got from bad traces: 
```
Request: {
  Authorization: Bearer <token>,
  Content-Type: application/json
  // MISSING: x-tenant-id header
}
Upstream error: missing-tenant-header -> auth-reject -> 502
```
christine: Good rollback. Next actions: 1) postmortem; 2) add e2e test verifying x-tenant-id is present in canary path; 3) change config schema to reject selector=tenant_id without header mapping.
dana: Opening postmortem doc and adding AcmeCorp incident link. Will prepare customer-facing note.
sre-oncall: Marking incident resolved for P1 alert. Will continue 1hr watch.
ryan: Quick follow-up discovery — the canary harness used a default selector value of empty-string for non-mapped requests. We'll add a safety guard to treat empty selector as no-match (0%).
mike: Routing p50/p95 back to baseline. No further 5xx spike in the last 10m.
billing: Logged follow-up ticket to reconcile usage failures with finance (FIN-579).
christine: Thanks everyone. We'll schedule a blameless postmortem and update the rollout runbook with a step to validate header propagation before enabling tenant routing.
dana: Closing thread once watch window ends. :lock:
